audit_details: Audited 7 configuration files (mission_center.json, agent_permissions.json, builder_guard.json, agent_registry.json, opencode.json, AGENTS.md, job_scheduler.json). Single-writer rule is consistently enforced across all files: only SUPRA-Builder has write permissions. All 8 read-only agents have edit/write/create/delete denied. builder_guard.json defines 8 write operations and 4 guard rules. Write request protocol exists in both agent_permissions.json (5 steps) and builder_guard.json (8 steps + schema) but lacks failure recovery. 7 violations found: 1 inconsistency in SUPRA-Refactor bash config, 2 agents missing from mission_center pipeline roles, 1 incomplete permission mirroring, 1 undefined validation stamp, 1 bash indirect write gap, 1 missing failure handling in protocol, 1 naming inconsistency. Score: 0.89 — strong enforcement architecture with documentation and edge-case gaps.
